hotel_name: Evora – Banquet Halls & Hotel | Perfect For Weddings & Events

positive_snippets: Terrace is perfect place for parties and functions in winters. Food quality is also good. We had an engagement there. Snacks were delicious. So was full course meal as well. Everything was top notch. They had made good arrangements for the engagement as well - flowers, decorations, music, everything

We recently celebrated our baby’s 2nd birthday along with a Jagran at Evora Banquet, and the experience was absolutely amazing. The ambience was beautiful, the decoration was well done, and the overall setup created a very positive and festive vibe.

The hospitality was excellent—staff was polite, supportive, and managed everything smoothly throughout the event. From arrangements to coordination, everything was handled professionally, which made the function completely stress-free for us.

Overall, a wonderful experience. Highly recommended for family functions, birthdays, and religious events.

We had Haldi Mehndi functions of my sister's wedding here (6th Nov 25). Everything went smoothly. The food , the decoration and the music was top notch.
Our guests stayed here for 2 nights , rooms were clean and spacious. Service was good and quick.
Overall good maintained rooms but there were a noticable dampy smell might be due to moisture.
negative_snippets:
I recently visited this banquet and had a very disappointing experience. I simply requested pasta in a small bowl, but the staff insisted that pasta is considered a “main course item” and could only be served on a full main plate. They refused to accommodate a simple and reasonable request.

This led to unnecessary arguments, which honestly spoiled the whole experience. In a banquet setting, flexibility and customer satisfaction should be a priority. Instead, the staff seemed rigid and unhelpful.

Very disappointed with the service attitude. Hope they improve their customer handling in the future.

Pankaj was the captain manager who did this
